note: Hotfix for the round-24 Schema derive regression: a builtin-named field type from a dependency crate (url::Url, http::StatusCode, tempfile::NamedTempFile) is no longer asserted to implement vespera::Schema, so such structs compile again and document the builtin schema. The user-module decision now follows the path's origin (crate/self/super or a non-extern root) instead of a crate-name list. Relative servers URLs reject whitespace, ? and #.
